paper: Clark et al., Think you have Solved Question Answering? Try ARC, the AI2 Reasoning Challenge, arXiv:1803.05457
selection_note: ARC-Challenge contains questions that both a retrieval baseline and a word-cooccurrence baseline failed in the original benchmark construction.

split_policy.validation: model selection, debugging, and routine benchmark iteration
split_policy.test: final confirmatory evaluation only; do not use for tuning

claim_boundary: This manifest establishes dataset identity and provenance only. Scientific claims require the declared model/baseline protocol, adequate training, multiple seeds, calibration, robustness, ablations, raw predictions, and independent reproduction.
